assembly.model_validation: 59 named declaration groups,12 declared members,36 gapfree semantic blocks,6 tests/17 assertion sites and44 exact insertion blocks. Filesystem readback is a separate required terminal receipt.
assembly.finalization: Complete child for root independent review, not formal acceptance.

coverage_basis.source_basis: All 859 original LF read completely from canonical checkout in C/D/E; manual declarations, fields/variants, continuous semantic blocks and direct statements below. Lexical locators are not an AST exhaustiveness proof.
no_claims: No Rust tests, benches, Cargo, Rustdoc, renderer or Python unittest execution.
No whole-workspace, Jenkins, milestone or production acceptance.
No formal coverage of R084/R086 shared map modules or any caller/reader context.
review_focus: Source UTF8 byte offsets, visual byte positions and main-axis advances are separate coordinate domains.
Owned paint output versus borrowed per-call row/maps; cache indexes belong to the same layout slice.
Separate endpoint monotonicity controls range candidate optimization; caret fallback is only candidate absent/not-covering, not global DTO validation.
Ordinary f32 frame arithmetic does not validate finite geometry or perform viewport clipping.
Ignored timings exclude fixture construction and compare their actual lookup output costs; sorted last sample is maximum of eleven, not an asserted percentile estimator.
coverage_basis.span_convention: before_lines refer to original checkout grant; after_lines to the same original declaration/control statements after comment insertions. Each gapfree block after_lines additionally includes new comment lines assigned at its original start or within it.
